name: Render Compliance
team_size_estimate: 2-10 (LinkedIn band; two named practitioners on site — 'small by design')

startup_focus_evidence.signal: Pricing page explicitly targets early-stage SaaS: Type 1 pitched as ideal for 'a Series A startup that just received their first enterprise security questionnaire'; smallest pricing band is 1-100 employees at $20K
Firm positions as a SOC 1/SOC 2 CPA firm exclusively for B2B SaaS companies, 'auditors fluent in SaaS infrastructure', 3-week report turnaround
Homepage headline market is SaaS companies 200-2,000 employees (slightly upstream of a 1-30 person ICP), but pricing bands and Series A messaging show they actively serve the startup end
Practitioner blog aimed at SaaS compliance/DevOps teams, e.g. 'SOC 2 Controls for AWS: A Practical Security Checklist for SaaS Teams'

grc_partnerships: Works regularly with Drata, Vanta, Secureframe, and Trust Cloud (per pricing-page FAQ: 'We work with Drata, Vanta, SecureFrame, Trust Cloud, and other GRC platforms regularly'); no formal listing found in Vanta/Drata public partner directories
aws_cloud_expertise: Strong for firm size: publishes AWS-specific SOC 2 control content covering IAM key rotation, prod/non-prod environment separation, resource tagging (EC2/S3/RDS), WAF, and GuardDuty; team lists AWS Security Fundamentals certification; blog references a free open-source 'AWS Audit Playbook' on GitHub and critiques generic GRC-tool control templates that 'fit like a bad pair of shoes' for AWS environments.
services: SOC 2+ (mapped to ISO 27001, HIPAA, HITRUST, FedRAMP)

partnership_angle: Referral partner + sandbox tester (Tester -> Validator -> Design Partner). A 2-person founder-led CPA firm founded in 2023 with genuine AWS configuration fluency is the ideal validator profile: Beau Butaud already writes hands-on AWS SOC 2 checklists and maintains open-source AWS audit tooling, so he can technically vet LoxeAI's scan output and, if satisfied, route pre-audit Series A prospects to it as a readiness step. Their published $20K small-band pricing means an inbound startup that isn't audit-ready is currently a stalled deal for them — LoxeAI gives them something to hand those prospects instead of losing them. Only caveat: headline positioning is SaaS 200-2,000 employees, slightly upstream of LoxeAI's 1-30 ICP, so frame LoxeAI as their funnel for the smaller inbound leads they'd otherwise turn away or park.
pitch_note: Beau — your AWS SOC 2 checklist (IAM rotation, env separation, GuardDuty) covers exactly what LoxeAI scans for automatically in AWS-native startups. Would you spend 30 minutes running it against a sandbox account and telling us where it's wrong? If it holds up to your standards, you'd have a concrete answer for the pre-Series-A inbounds that aren't ready for your $20K engagement yet: 'run this scan first — it gets you 80% ready,' and they come back to Render audit-ready instead of ghosting.
